newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open unchanged.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open unchanged.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged Friday, floor trader said.

London white sugar prices were up slightly, but facing stiff resistance at $330. Fundamentally, the market is finding support with August being the seasonally tight period for white sugar. At 0848EDT/1244 GMT, LIFFE October was $329.00 with a range of $328-$329.
Thursday, CSCE's benchmark October contract closed up 0.10 cent at 11.68 cents a lb after trading from 11.55 to 11.70 cents.
